## Summary

Kaustubh Bagale is a full stack developer and final-year Computer Science
Engineering student at Parul University, Vadodara, India. He builds production
web platforms end to end: React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and
Express on the back end, MongoDB or PostgreSQL for data, and Docker, Nginx and
Vercel for deployment. His work focuses on scalability and cloud computing —
the systems he has shipped include a university convocation portal that served
100,000 concurrent users at 99.9% uptime. He is available for freelance,
contract and full-time software engineering work, remote or in India.

## Projects

### 01 — Parul University Convocation Portal
Live: offline since the ceremony ended — source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/convocation-pu
Source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/convocation-pu
Year: 2024–2025. Stack: React.js, Node.js, Nginx, DevOps.
End-to-end management system that streamlines graduation ceremonies for
thousands of graduands. A high-performance platform with Nginx load balancing
handling 100,000 concurrent users at 99.9% uptime, built as a dual-interface
system — one surface for students, one for administrators.

### 02 — University Admission Portal
Live: https://parul-student-hub.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/student-hub
Year: 2024–2026. Stack: MERN stack, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
Full-stack portal serving 1,000+ first-year students. Its self-service
verification workflow reduced administrative time by roughly 40% and
eliminated a class of manual data-entry errors. Fully responsive, built for a
100 Lighthouse performance score.

### 03 — Client Portfolio
Year: 2025. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
Fully responsive client portfolio achieving a 100 Lighthouse performance
score. Pixel-perfect, mobile-first interface with seamless cross-browser
compatibility.

### 04 — MovieVerse
Source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/movieverse-pu
Year: 2024. Stack: Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, microservices.
Movie viewing platform on a microservices-inspired architecture, with JWT
authentication, bcrypt password hashing and database queries tuned for
scalable retrieval.

### 05 — Spotify Downloader
Source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/song-ripper
Year: 2024. Stack: React, Express.js, FFmpeg, yt-dlp.
Full-stack media processing application interfacing with yt-dlp and FFmpeg,
with backend streams optimized for high-quality audio at minimal server
latency.

### 06 — AI README Generator
Source: https://github.com/baggiii1013/readme-generator
Year: 2024. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, AI integration, developer tooling.
Parses project structures and generates documentation with AI, automating
section generation to cut documentation setup time.

## Frequently asked questions

**Who is Kaustubh Bagale?**
Kaustubh Bagale is a full stack developer and final-year Computer Science
Engineering student at Parul University, India. He builds web applications end
to end — React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and Express on the back
end — with a focus on scalability, cloud computing, and DevOps practices such
as containerisation and load balancing.

**What does Kaustubh Bagale build?**
Production web platforms rather than demos. His work includes the Parul
University Convocation Portal, a dual-interface system that handled 100,000
concurrent users at 99.9% uptime behind Nginx load balancing, and a live
university admission portal serving 1,000+ students whose self-service
verification workflow cut administrative time by roughly 40%.

**What technologies does he work with?**
Day to day: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
and Tailwind CSS — the MERN stack plus the Next.js App Router. Alongside those
he works in Java, Python, C++ and Rust, with PostgreSQL and Firebase for data,
and Docker, Nginx, Git, AWS and Vercel for deployment and infrastructure.

**Is Kaustubh Bagale available for freelance or full-time work?**
Yes. He takes on freelance and contract web development work and is open to
full-time software engineering roles, remote or based in India. Typical
engagements are full stack web applications, Next.js sites and performance or
infrastructure work on existing systems.

**How do you get in touch with him?**
Email kaustubhbagale10@gmail.com or call +91 8767943262. He is also reachable
on GitHub (@baggiii1013), LinkedIn and X. His résumé is downloadable from the
tech stack section of this site, and the contact card is the last panel of the
homepage.

**What makes his approach to building software different?**
He designs for the load a system will actually see. That means measuring
before optimising, keeping bundles small enough to hit a 100 Lighthouse
performance score, choosing boring and well-understood infrastructure over
novelty, and writing services that degrade gracefully instead of failing
outright when traffic spikes.
